description: React component for a quiz modal in a learner course module, handling quiz generation, answering, submission, and displaying results.

methods.name: handleStart
methods.description: Initiates quiz generation by calling generateAiQuiz API, sets questions and state accordingly.

methods.name: handleAnswer
methods.description: Records user's answer for the current question.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Submits answers via submitAiQuiz API, updates score and feedback.

methods.name: handleRetake
methods.description: Resets quiz state to start over.
